paragraphs: From Longford test centre on Ardnacassa Avenue, move off when safe and take the 1st left to stay on Ardnacassa Avenue
Continue for a short distance turn right onto Major's Well Road and follow it out for just over a kilometre, keeping an eye on your speed and position as the road opens up
At the roundabout ahead take the slight left exit onto the Longford Bypass
Stay on the bypass, watching for lane discipline and traffic joining from slip roads
At the Red Cow Roundabout, again take the slight left exit and follow signs toward White Linen Woods
At the next roundabout turn left into the White Linen Woods estate

Practice your observations at each junction as you continue through the estate roads, staying with White Linen Woods as it bends right and then right again, before reaching another roundabout where you turn left onto Battery Road
Follow Battery Road for about a kilometre into town
Turn right onto Church Street take the next left onto Great Water Street
Continuing on, the road name changes to Blind Man's Walk stay straight
Take the right into College Park, straight across a small unnamed road, and left to continue in College Park
Work your way back through College Park, keeping right at the two continue points, then at the end of the road turn right onto Major's Well Road
Take the next left into Oakvale, which becomes Ardnacassa Avenue, and follow the estate roads with careful observation at each junction
To finish, follow Ardnacassa Avenue back through the estate, turning right, right again
Left to stay on Ardnacassa Avenue turn right onto Major's Well Road, left into College Park, and at the end of the road turn left
Left again onto Blind Man's Walk to return toward the Longford test centre
